page.layout: One page, blank apart from a handwritten ownership inscription at the very top, which is not printed and is left out. Faint traces of print lie in the upper-middle and lower part of the page, but they are too indistinct to read, and they appear to be show-through from the other side.
page.notes: No printed text can be read on this scan. The handwritten inscription at the top ("Griffin St. Edmund Hall Oxford") is a later ownership note and is not transcribed. Faint, possibly printed traces around the upper third and in the lower third are too faded to read and may be show-through; they are not transcribed. A re-scan with more contrast, or the recto/verso of this leaf, would be needed to confirm whether this is a blank leaf or a title page.
